Name: MuJoCo 4
Tagline: A physics engine for robots with its own studio
Topics: Open Source, Robots, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

Name: Co-Review
Tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

Name: Coffee
Tagline: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes
Description: Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

Name: Latch.ai
Tagline: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
Description: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

Name: Seldon
Tagline: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do
Description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

Name: Opal Reader
Tagline: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo
Description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

Name: AppTraction
Tagline: Supercharge Apple App Store analytics
Description: AppTraction is a native Mac app that makes App Store Connect make sense. Your sales, analytics, ratings, and reviews live on your Mac and appear instantly. It monitors your apps, flags problems, trends, and milestones, and writes weekly, monthly, and annual reports. Its AI evaluates your listing and helps fix it, and you can chat about any chart or report. It’s primed with Apple’s own ASO advice and uses your existing Claude or Codex subscription. Your data is stored only on your Mac.

Name: CollaboTokyo
Tagline: Explore a virtual Tokyo to network, market, and collaborate
Description: What if networking felt more like exploring a city than scrolling through a feed? CollaboTokyo is a virtual Tokyo where creators, builders, entrepreneurs, and brands from around the world meet, discover projects, and collaborate. The city is broken up into districts & neighborhoods each with its own category/topic so you can explore and share project, work, and ideas with people in the same niche. Explore the city. Meet people. Make things happen.

Name: Ember
Tagline: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click
Description: Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

Name: Almanzor
Tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
Description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

Name: Rodeo
Tagline: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan
Description: Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

Name: Alsona
Tagline: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
Description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

Name: Lottie AI
Tagline: Editable vector animations from a text prompt
Description: Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

Name: Maxma
Tagline: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
Description: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

Name: Kettle
Tagline: The helper in your family group chat
Description: Kettle is a helper in your family's group chat. There's no app and nothing to set up: text it on its own, or start a group message with "Kettle." It remembers the details you tell it, plans dinners around your week, builds a grocery cart for you to review and check out, and sends group or private reminders plus a short morning brief. Getting started: text hi, each person texts once so it knows who's who, then add Kettle to the group. 7 days free, then $19 a month for the whole family.

Name: AppuBot
Tagline: AI teammates that use your real apps, on your Mac or cloud
Topics: Android, Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

Name: Dover Startup Jobs
Tagline: Where great startups meet great candidates
Description: Dover Startup Jobs helps venture-backed startups attract great candidates for free. Reach people who want to work at startups, post jobs in any region, publish in one click, and manage every applicant in one place.

Name: gitmanual
Tagline: See if a GitHub repo runs on your OS, and how to set it up
Description: Know if a GitHub project will run on your computer before you clone it. Paste any repo link and get its setup manual: a yes/no verdict for macOS, Windows or Linux, everything you need to install, and the exact steps, or one setup script. It reads the repo's own files, no AI guessing, and links to the maintainers' guide when unsure. Swap "hub" for "manual" in any GitHub URL, use the Chrome extension, or the MCP server for AI assistants. Works on private repos. Free and open source.

Name: Clive
Tagline: Let Claude and other AI's set your iphone alarms
Description: A lot of us run our lives with alarms, but setting them one at a time is a hassle. With Clive, you can ask Claude to set them for you, even from your calendar, through Apple's AlarmKit. In the app, Clive walks to the right instrument and plays it.

Name: Kata Send
Tagline: Cold email infrastructure for AI agents
Description: Kata Send lets your AI agent run cold email. One command from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: Kata checks the addresses, writes the emails, sends from warmed inboxes and follows up in the same thread. It reads replies, clicks and sales, then sends more of the version that sells. Daily caps and auto pause protect deliverability. Start with no domains at $0.04 per email, or connect your own inboxes from $29 a month. $10 free to start.
